mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_user_white_list (ID, USER_NAME, NICK_NAME, TENANT_ID, TENANT_NAME, PHONE_NUMBER, SOURCE, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME) VALUES (UUID_SHORT(), #{userName}, #{nickName}, #{tenantId}, #{tenantName}, #{phoneNumber}, #{source}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT a.USER_NAME, a.NICK_NAME, a.TENANT_NAME, a.PHONE_NUMBER AS phone_number, CONCAT( SUBSTRING( a.PHONE_NUMBER, 1, 3 ), '****', SUBSTRING( a.PHONE_NUMBER, 8 )) AS phone_number_desensitization, a.tenant_id, IF ( a.tenant_id IS NULL, '0', '1' ) AS `source` FROM sys_user_white_list a WHERE a.USER_NAME = #{userName} and DELETE_FLAG=0

SELECT DISTINCT t.USER_NAME FROM sys_user t WHERE t.del_flag = '0'
AND (t.tenant_id IN
#{item}
or t.user_type = '0')
AND t.user_type = '0'
ORDER BY CONVERT ( t.USER_NAME USING GBK )
SELECT tenant_id FROM vm_order_customer WHERE ord_status IN ( 0, 1, 2 ) AND accept_node = #{platformCode}
SELECT a.tenant_name FROM sys_tenant_info a WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.del_flag = 0

SELECT ID, USER_NAME, NICK_NAME, TENANT_ID, TENANT_NAME, CONCAT(SUBSTRING(PHONE_NUMBER,1,3),'****',SUBSTRING(PHONE_NUMBER,8)) AS PHONE_NUMBER, `SOURCE` FROM sys_user_white_list WHERE DELETE_FLAG = '0'
AND USER_NAME LIKE concat('%',#{userName},'%')
AND NICK_NAME LIKE concat('%',#{nickName},'%')
AND PHONE_NUMBER LIKE concat('%',#{phoneNumber},'%')
AND (TENANT_ID LIKE concat('%',#{tenantId},'%') OR TENANT_NAME LIKE concat('%',#{tenantId},'%'))
AND `SOURCE` = #{source}
order by create_time desc
